name: pointer-anchor-object-type-mismatch
description: a sub-flow's pointer target anchor given an object instead of a string reports the mismatch as "got object", proving a script-parsed nested mapping renders its JavaScript typeof rather than its Go type name
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: pointer anchor type mismatch
---
- launchApp
- runFlow:
    file: "{{DIR}}/bad-anchor.yml"

flowFiles.bad-anchor.yml:
appId: com.bad
---
- pointer:
    touches:
      - actions:
          - down:
              selector:
                id: target
              anchor: {}
          - up
